name: apiosk-mcp
description: Buy an API call the way a person would: describe the job, see what can do it, compare the candidates on price and measured performance, choose one, and pay for it in USDC under limits you set. The buyer sets the rules at buy.apiosk.com; the gateway enforces them on every call.
author: Apiosk

tools.name: apiosk_connect
tools.description: Report whether this session can buy: connected, payable, which wallet, which policy, which limits. Returns the buy.apiosk.com link when there is no connection. Spends nothing.

tools.name: apiosk_discover
tools.description: Describe a job in plain words and get the APIs that can do it, ranked, from the Apiosk catalogue and the wider x402 ecosystem. Spends nothing.

tools.name: apiosk_compare
tools.description: Put the candidates side by side on price, measured p95 latency, measured success rate and input fit, each offer carrying a stable offer_id to choose from. Spends nothing.

tools.name: apiosk_execute
tools.description: Run the offer the user chose, under the price ceiling they saw, and return the result. This is the one tool that spends money.

tools.name: apiosk_approval_status
tools.description: Read the state of a purchase the buyer's rules put on hold: pending, approved, denied or expired. Spends nothing.
